detected_items.description: Certa is the leading AI-powered third-party lifecycle management platform that helps enterprises manage risk, compliance, and ESG across their vendor, partner, and client ecosystems. Founded in 2013 by Jag Lamba, Certa automates third-party onboarding, due diligence, KYC/AML, contract lifecycle management, and ongoing monitoring through a no-code SaaS platform trusted by Fortune 500 companies. Certa leverages generative AI to streamline workflows, enrich data from trusted sources, and surface actionable risk intelligence — enabling organizations to onboard third parties 3x faster while maintaining comprehensive risk coverage across InfoSec, Privacy, Financial, Fraud, and ESG domains.
